name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko's journey into motorsport HR began unconventionally. After graduating with a degree in psychology, he initially worked in corporate HR, but his passion for racing, fueled by childhood memories of watching rallies with his father, never waned. He started volunteering at local karting events, eventually leveraging his HR skills to assist teams with recruitment and compliance. This led to a position at a smaller racing outfit before he was headhunted by RSC Motorsport.

At RSC Motorsport, Marko focuses on creating a supportive and high-performance environment. He's a strong believer in clear communication and fair treatment, implementing strategies to boost employee morale and reduce turnover. He's known for his pragmatic approach, always seeking practical solutions to complex HR challenges. He's particularly adept at navigating the unique demands of the high-pressure motorsport industry, balancing the needs of the team with the well-being of its members.

What sets Marko apart is his data-driven approach to HR. He constantly analyzes employee performance and satisfaction metrics to identify areas for improvement. He's also a strong advocate for diversity and inclusion, actively working to create a more representative workforce within RSC Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Marko has a strong, defined jawline and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized desk, even in the chaotic environment of the paddock.
